name: feedback-action-scope
body: The feedback-action capability (`apg_review_action`) is held only by the coordinator. Every writer agent the suite defines or scaffolds — the spec-writer, the plan-writer, the implementer, and every test-implementer the agent-builder scaffolds — holds read-only feedback access (`apg_review`) and must never action, resolve, or reject feedback; reviewers attach, resolve, and reject but never action. A writer's disposition is a claim returned to the coordinator, not a state transition.
